title: The flagship delivers operational value; establish its full return
subtitle: M1 Northstar leadership review 2026-08-01 to 2026-08-31
lead: 97,488 automated tickets demonstrate a meaningful operating footprint
body: The CSV records 789,563 model requests and 68.0% automation across the month. The final week reached 70.1% automation, compared with 65.8% in the opening week. The operating opportunity is to absorb routine demand while experienced staff handle exceptions.
decision: First assess flagship benefits against implementation and ongoing costs. Use that evidence to decide whether expansion is worth funding.
note: Source: supplied Northstar case brief and synthetic daily metrics. Reporting period 2026-08-01 to 2026-08-31.
talkingPoint: Automation rose from 65.8% to 70.1% over the month, indicating steady improvement in handling tier-1 tickets.

sections.heading: Flagship assessment
sections.text: Complete full-cost accounting and benefit validation. If net value is positive, authorize expansion planning.

sections.heading: Pilot scope
sections.text: Single brand, 4-week test, reversible. Measure automation rate, quality, cost per ticket, and customer satisfaction.

sections.heading: Risk controls
sections.text: Policy owner review, peak-load tests, rollback plan. Human oversight on all AI recommendations until proven.
